title: DABCO-catalysed highly diastereoselective synthesis of 1,3-indandione containing fully saturated spirocyclopentanes involving 2-(2′-ketoalkyl)-1,3-indandiones and nitrostyrenes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30768-30780
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04224K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Gitanjali Mishra, Missa Saril Bobonga, Khadimul Islam, Arundhuti Chakraborty, Barla Thirupathi
Synthesis of functionalized 1,3-indandione containing spirocyclopentanes has been achieved in a highly diastereoselective manner in presence of catalytic amount of DABCO by the reaction of 2-(2′-ketoalkyl)-1,3-indandiones with nitrostyrenes.
